name: solution-architecture
description: Engagement architecture. Skills: requirements-defaults (discovery matrix to docs/<slug>-nfr-discovery.md; ask envelope first), rscop-analysis (measurable Reliability, Security, Cost, Operations, and Performance rows), solutions-architecture-document (SAD from that RSCOP; links ADRs), architecture-decision-records (authors ADRs: status, supersedes, options, consequences; MADR or Y-statement), c4-diagrams (Context and Container, plus Deployment when asked; modes design / prose / review / update), requirements (feature-level living spec with FR-* and NFR-* IDs), astro-elt-contexts (Astro, Airflow, and dbt warehouse ELT). Use defaults, then RSCOP, then SAD for an engagement; write decisions with architecture-decision-records; emit diagrams with c4-diagrams; use requirements for a single feature; use astro-elt-contexts for pipeline code.
